brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, ideally 1792x1024 or 1600x900 and at least 1000 pixels wide. This is a newly drawn raster illustration for バスケまとめ.

Visual direction: emulate the approved black-and-lime thumbnail viewed earlier ONLY for its hand-drawn ink / dry-brush aesthetic, bold Japanese typography, restrained elements, charcoal #151A18 ground, electric lime #CCF43B and warm off-white. Do not carry over any player, player name, scores, dates or statistics from that style reference. Not photorealistic. Dynamic sophisticated editorial sports illustration with strong brush strokes and subtly textured paper.

Subject: exactly one REAL player, 山本翔太 / Shota Yamamoto of Kumamoto Volters, selected randomly from the fixed article's listed players. Use the official portrait viewed in this conversation as appearance guidance: https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026110705/files/user/roster/724/2026-27/51000156_01.jpg . He is a young Japanese adult, strong athletic guard build, pale-medium warm skin, dense black short tousled hair with a broad textured fringe across the forehead, compact oval face with softly squared lower jaw, straight dark eyebrows, small almond-shaped dark eyes, a straight small broad nose, full closed lips, clean-shaven. Preserve these distinctive features in an ink drawing, do not substitute a generic/fictitious athlete, do not give him a beard, braids or curly high top. Draw a clear three-quarter face, calm focused expression.

Composition: player occupies the LEFT 43% with full head and both hands clearly visible, driving diagonally toward the center, knees bent, torso leaning and twisting, holding ONE orange basketball low beside his hip with both hands in a natural gathering motion. Anatomically believable shoulders, elbows, wrists, hands and five fingers per hand; no extra limbs. White unbranded basketball singlet and shorts with black ink shading and minimal dark trim, absolutely NO jersey numbers, names, letters, sponsors or logos. Make the figure a convincing likeness and active basketball pose. Legs may naturally finish above the bottom footer, all figure elements and ball inside the canvas with comfortable margins. Lime diagonal brush strokes behind the figure imply motion, sparse ink flecks. No other figures or silhouettes, no scoreboard or arena advertisements.

Typography: clean large ultra-bold Japanese gothic with a little tactile print texture, very readable at thumbnail size. Keep the RIGHT 52% for text, strong negative space, nothing covering the face/ball. All text on canvas must be exactly the following, and nothing else:
Top-right small header: 「2026.11.04｜B.ONE」
Main right heading first line in off-white: 「試合結果」
Main right heading second line in lime: 「当日のEFF」
Right below, medium bold off-white: 「ポジション別TOP3」
Bottom-left footer, clear and legible: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Bottom-right footer, clear and legible: 「イメージ」

The Japanese corner brackets above are delimiters, NOT part of the image text. Do not add a player name, personal stats, a score, claims about participation or achievement, or any other words. TOP3 refers to the article's POSITION-SPECIFIC rankings, not a single overall ranking. This is an illustrative imagined generic basketball movement, not a recreation of any actual play or the November 4 game. Do not imply a winning basket, result-specific celebration or actual photographed action. The only article content used is the fixed provided source.html/source.txt: Nov 4, 2026 B.ONE results and that day's official EFF positional Top 3. Official photo is solely likeness reference; no photo pasted in. All content must be newly illustrated, no official team / league logos. Generous outer safe margins of at least 4%. Deliver one polished complete image.

SINGLE ALLOWED REVISION
Edit this existing thumbnail with ONE targeted correction: improve the composition safe margins. Preserve every text character, the date 2026.11.04, B.ONE, 試合結果, 当日のEFF, ポジション別TOP3, イラスト（AI生成）, イメージ, the black #151A18 / lime #CCF43B / off-white palette, ink-and-brush illustrative style, the identity/face/hair of real player Shota Yamamoto, his two-handed driving gather pose, basketball and blank unbranded uniform. Do not add any name, jersey number, personal statistic, new wording, person or logo. The first image has the hair at the TOP edge and the leftmost hand at the LEFT edge. Zoom the illustrated PLAYER AND BALL out by about 12%, move them slightly inward so the entire top of the hair and all fingers and the ball have at least 50 pixels of clear charcoal background inside the canvas. Preserve the readable face likeness, natural anatomy, and TWO hands with five fingers each. Keep the text on the right and the footer clearly separated from the figure, with a 50-pixel safety margin around all text as well. A deliberate lower-thigh crop at the bottom is okay, but never crop hair, face, hands, ball or letters. Keep the final aspect ratio about 16:9, at least 1000 pixels wide. This remains an imagined illustrative movement, not a recreation of any actual game action. No photography. Produce one corrected complete thumbnail.
